model_interpretation.claim: A 256-thread tiled first pass processing 2048 contiguous elements per CTA should reduce launch count and partial volume versus the baseline's 128-element passes. When the first pass still produces more than 1024 partials, a scratch-backed intermediate pass may outperform making one CTA consume the entire partial array; the threshold explicitly tests the extra-launch tradeoff without atomic accumulation.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["Replace the baseline's 128-element reduction passes with a coalesced 256-thread first pass that handles eight values per thread and masks the tail.","Reduce modest partial arrays in one final device-sum kernel; above 1024 first-pass partials, use a second scratch-backed tiled pass followed by a final sum.","Keep accumulation non-atomic, preserve the existing second scratch-region offset for the multistage path, and retain a device-to-device copy for n=1."]}

model_interpretation.claim: With the existing 128-thread blocks and unchanged one-element-per-thread mapping, reduce0 performs seven CTA-wide barriers in its shared-memory tree. Reducing each warp with the existing sync-intrinsic helper, writing one partial per warp, then using one CTA barrier and a warp-0 reduction may reduce synchronization overhead. The tail remains zero-padded and every launched lane participates. The baseline is correct at a mean 47.08 µs; no candidate speedup or correctness is claimed before controller evaluation.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["Retain the same global load mapping and zero-pad out-of-range tail elements, but keep each loaded value in a register for the warp reduction.","Use the existing warpReduceSum helper with __activemask() for each warp; on the supplied SM 8.0+ target the int specialization uses __reduce_add_sync.","Have lane 0 of each warp write its partial sum to shared memory; use one __syncthreads() before warp 0 reduces the partials and writes the block result.","Leave run's 128-thread launch, reduction pass loop, scratch selection, and output copy unchanged."]}

items.subject: Combinaison mesurée de la hiérarchie T1 et de la réduction intra-bloc T2
items.objective: À partir du candidat T1 le plus rapide, intégrer le mécanisme de réduction intra-bloc du candidat T2 dans la hiérarchie tuilée de T1. Préserver le calcul complet sur GPU, la correction pour toutes les entrées et les contraintes de scratch/flux par défaut; mesurer le programme intégré entier.
